# -----------------------------------------------------------
# OpenAI Specific Rules
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# 1. ALLOW ChatGPT Search
# This allows your site to appear in ChatGPT's search answers.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/

# 2. DISALLOW AI Model Training
# This stops OpenAI from using your site's content to train their AI models.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

# 3. ALLOW ChatGPT Users (Optional but recommended)
# This allows users who are actively chatting with ChatGPT to fetch links from your site.
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# General Rules for all other bots (Google, Bing, etc.)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
